purpose: Validate P6D on one real Safari document. The test-owned semantic marker changes from BETA to ALPHA while the visual canvas target stays unchanged. A fresh semantic observation establishes ALPHA before the positive runTask.
requiredClaims: BETA rejects the ALPHA surface precondition before perception-provider selection.
The same Safari document transitions from BETA to ALPHA with the same canvas target.
A fresh Computer Control snapshot establishes ALPHA before positive execution.
ALPHA verifies the surface precondition before lazy provider selection.
The positive path reaches visual fallback only after NO_SEMANTIC_TARGET.
CLICK_POSTED remains delivery only and VERIFIED_SUCCESS requires independent post-action observation.
Screenshot bytes, OCR payloads and coordinates remain outside session evidence.
Test resources and product trees are clean after execution.
nonClaims: No generic Safari visual fallback is enabled.
No test-owned PROCEED or FINISHED contract is promoted as built-in Safari knowledge.
No planner coordinates or provider objects are introduced.

lineage.change: Replace the second Safari URL navigation with a deterministic semantic marker transition in the already active document.
